# crates_compare MCP tool

> Compare two or more crates side by side with the best crate per metric. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the crates_compare MCP tool.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-compare/

Compare two or more crates side by side with the best crate per metric.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "crates_compare",
    "arguments": {
      "names": []
    }
  }
}
```

| `live` | `boolean` | no |  |
